# Glitch PR

> Glitch PR, founded by Aaron Cohen, PR and AI search visibility for AI and B2B tech companies. Senior-led: the person clients meet is the person who does the work. Based in Portland, Oregon.

Glitch PR earns press coverage for AI and B2B tech companies and turns it into citations in AI engines such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude and Google AI. Services: technology PR (launches, funding news, media relations, founder visibility), generative engine optimization (GEO), and a fixed-scope AI visibility audit. Sectors include AI, SaaS, hardware, robotics, manufacturing and construction tech. Clients have included Oracle, RealWear and Replika.

## Pages

- [AI PR agency](https://www.glitchpr.com/ai-pr-agency): PR for AI companies, including physical AI and hardware
- [Startup PR](https://www.glitchpr.com/startup-pr): PR for AI and tech founders, seed through growth
- [GEO services](https://www.glitchpr.com/geo-services): generative engine optimization for AI and B2B tech
- [AI visibility audit](https://www.glitchpr.com/ai-visibility-audit): how AI engines describe a company and what to fix
- [PR is back. AI search is why.](https://www.glitchpr.com/why-pr-matters-for-ai-search): research on earned media and AI citations
- [Work](https://www.glitchpr.com/work): selected clients
